title: Record complete run telemetry
rationale: Costs, retrieval, failures, and artifacts must be auditable.
acceptance_test: Every run writes a manifest and valid JSONL with IDs, timings, tokens, costs, and validation events
sdd_snippet: Each run writes metrics.jsonl, code, validator output, run settings, and complete cost accounting. Run manifests and JSONL events use versioned Pydantic models.
